SUPPLY AGREEMENT

This Supply Agreement is made as of August 1, 2023 between Acme Manufacturing LLC
("Buyer") and Cedar Components GmbH, a German limited liability company ("Seller").

TERM. This Agreement continues until terminated by either party on 30 days notice.

GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

CHANGE OF CONTROL. Upon a change of control of Buyer, Seller may terminate this Agreement
on thirty (30) days written notice. "Change of control" means the acquisition of more than
fifty percent (50%) of the voting securities of a party, whether directly or indirectly.

This Agreement has not been signed by either party.
